001package com.streamconverter.examples.docs;
002
003import com.streamconverter.CommandResult;
004import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
005import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
006import com.streamconverter.command.impl.LineEndingNormalizeCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.command.impl.LineEndingNormalizeCommand.LineEndingType;
008import com.streamconverter.command.impl.charcode.CharacterConvertCommand;
009import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvFilterCommand;
010import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
011import com.streamconverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
012import com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
013import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
014import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
015import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
016import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
017import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
018import java.io.InputStream;
019import java.io.OutputStream;
020import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
021import java.util.List;
022
023/**
024 * Verifiable code examples for StreamConverter documentation.
025 *
026 * <p>This class contains actual, compilable, and runnable code examples that are referenced from
027 * documentation. Each example is marked with START/END comments for potential extraction into
028 * documentation.
029 *
030 * <p>All examples in this file are tested to ensure they compile and execute correctly.
031 */
032public class BasicUsageExamples {
033
034  // [START csv-navigate-basic]
035  /**
036   * Basic CSV navigation example - applies transformation rule to specific column. Preserves entire
037   * CSV structure.
038   */
039  public void csvNavigateBasic() throws Exception {
040    // Sample CSV data
041    String csvData = "id,productName,price\n" + "1,Apple,100\n" + "2,Banana,50\n";
042    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
043    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
044
045    // Create command to process 'productName' column
046    IStreamCommand csvCommand =
047        new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("productName"), new PassThroughRule());
048
049    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {csvCommand});
050    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
051
052    // Verify execution
053    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
054    if (!success) {
055      throw new RuntimeException("CSV navigation failed");
056    }
057  }
058
059  // [END csv-navigate-basic]
060
061  // [START csv-filter-basic]
062  /**
063   * CSV filter example - extracts only specified columns. Outputs only selected columns, removes
064   * others.
065   */
066  public void csvFilterBasic() throws Exception {
067    String csvData = "id,name,price\n" + "1,Apple,100\n" + "2,Banana,50\n";
068    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
069    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
070
071    // Extract only 'price' column (assumes header exists)
072    IStreamCommand filterCommand = CsvFilterCommand.create(new CSVPath("price"));
073
074    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {filterCommand});
075    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
076
077    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
078    if (!success) {
079      throw new RuntimeException("CSV filter failed");
080    }
081  }
082
083  // [END csv-filter-basic]
084
085  // [START json-navigate-basic]
086  /**
087   * JSON navigation example - applies transformation rule to specific elements. Preserves entire
088   * JSON structure.
089   */
090  public void jsonNavigateBasic() throws Exception {
091    String jsonData = "{\"user\": {\"name\": \"John\", \"age\": 30}}";
092    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(jsonData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
093    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
094
095    // Process 'user.name' element
096    IStreamCommand jsonCommand =
097        new JsonNavigateCommand(TreePath.fromJson("$.user.name"), new PassThroughRule());
098
099    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {jsonCommand});
100    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
101
102    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
103    if (!success) {
104      throw new RuntimeException("JSON navigation failed");
105    }
106  }
107
108  // [END json-navigate-basic]
109
110  // [START xml-navigate-basic]
111  /**
112   * XML navigation example - applies transformation rule to specific elements. Preserves entire XML
113   * structure.
114   */
115  public void xmlNavigateBasic() throws Exception {
116    String xmlData = "<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><root><user><name>John</name></user></root>";
117    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(xmlData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
118    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
119
120    // Process 'root/user/name' element
121    IStreamCommand xmlCommand =
122        new XmlNavigateCommand(TreePath.fromXml("root/user/name"), new PassThroughRule());
123
124    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {xmlCommand});
125    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
126
127    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
128    if (!success) {
129      throw new RuntimeException("XML navigation failed");
130    }
131  }
132
133  // [END xml-navigate-basic]

135  // [START character-convert-basic]
136  /** Character encoding conversion example. Converts from Shift_JIS to UTF-8. */
137  public void characterConvertBasic() throws Exception {
138    String data = "Hello World";
139    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(data.getBytes("Shift_JIS"));
140    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
141
142    // Convert from Shift_JIS to UTF-8
143    IStreamCommand convertCommand = new CharacterConvertCommand("Shift_JIS", "UTF-8");
144
145    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {convertCommand});
146    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
147
148    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
149    if (!success) {
150      throw new RuntimeException("Character conversion failed");
151    }
152  }
153
154  // [END character-convert-basic]
155
156  // [START line-ending-normalize-basic]
157  /** Line ending normalization example. Normalizes line endings to Unix format (LF). */
158  public void lineEndingNormalizeBasic() throws Exception {
159    String data = "Line 1\r\nLine 2\rLine 3\n";
160    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
161    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
162
163    // Normalize to Unix line endings (LF)
164    IStreamCommand normalizeCommand = new LineEndingNormalizeCommand(LineEndingType.UNIX);
165
166    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {normalizeCommand});
167    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
168
169    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
170    if (!success) {
171      throw new RuntimeException("Line ending normalization failed");
172    }
173  }
174
175  // [END line-ending-normalize-basic]
176
177  // [START pipeline-simple]
178  /** Simple pipeline example - chaining multiple commands. */
179  public void simplePipeline() throws Exception {
180    String csvData = "id,name,price\n1,Apple,100\n";
181    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes("Shift_JIS"));
182    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
183
184    // CSV → Character conversion → Output
185    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
186      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
187      new CharacterConvertCommand("Shift_JIS", "UTF-8")
188    };
189
190    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
191    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
192
193    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
194    if (!success) {
195      throw new RuntimeException("Pipeline execution failed");
196    }
197  }
198
199  // [END pipeline-simple]
200
201  // [START error-handling-basic]
202  /** Error handling example using CommandResult. */
203  public void errorHandlingBasic() throws Exception {
204    String csvData = "id,name\n1,Apple\n";
205    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
206    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
207
208    IStreamCommand csvCommand = new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule());
209
210    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(new IStreamCommand[] {csvCommand});
211    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
212
213    // Check results
214    for (CommandResult result : results) {
215      if (!result.isSuccess()) {
216        System.err.println("Command failed: " + result.getCommandName());
217        System.err.println("Error: " + result.getErrorMessage());
218      } else {
219        System.out.println(
220            "Success: "
221                + result.getCommandName()
222                + " (duration: "
223                + result.getExecutionTimeMillis()
224                + "ms)");
225      }
226    }
227  }
228  // [END error-handling-basic]
229}
